headline: A new Castlevania game is coming!
title: Castlevania Belmont's Curse Release Date October 15 | Konami | Gaming News
video_script: Good news for Castlevania fans! Castlevania: Belmont's Curse has a release date of October fifteenth, twenty twenty six. Konami's new Castlevania is coming to PS5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch and PC. The Belmont family's fight against Dracula is one of gaming's oldest stories, and now a new chapter is on the way. Do you play Castlevania? Comment below!

scenes.sub: PS5 | Xbox Series X|S | Switch | PC

description: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse releases on October 15, 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and PC.
